title: Financial Hardship Request

character.name: Maya Okafor
character.description: You are Maya Okafor, a 28-year-old graphic designer living at Cedar Grove Apartments. Following an unexpected medical procedure and missed work, you are experiencing temporary financial difficulty.

objective: Use the AI assistant and letter editor to prepare a clear, persuasive request to your property manager for a temporary rent payment arrangement. Explain the situation, propose a realistic payment plan, and maintain a professional tone. Use relevant case information as needed; you do not need to include everything.
context: Your property manager has said that temporary arrangements may be considered if tenants submit a written explanation and a reasonable repayment proposal. No arrangement has been approved. All people, organizations, and details in this case are fictional. Do not enter your own personal information.
